guidance.summary: Consumer Durable division growth of 13% to 15% for the year
guidance.speaker: MANAGEMENT
guidance.quote: We remain optimistic that this division, Consumer Durable division, should grow in the range of 13% to 15 % for the year, driven by diversified product offering, adding wallet share within existing customers, expanding component businesses and expanding product baskets.

guidance.summary: PCB division margins to be 8% to 9% by year-end
guidance.speaker: MANAGEMENT
guidance.quote: We expect this division margins to be in the range of 8% to 9% by the year-end.

guidance.summary: Electronics division revenue plus INR 3,200 crores
guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: We are very hopeful. We are very hopeful that we should be plus INR3,200 crores in this division, Ankur.

guidance.summary: Electronics division margins in the range of 8% to 9% by year-end
guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: But we are very hopeful that we should be in the range of 8% to 9% range in this division by the year-end.

guidance.summary: Power-One revenue to deliver in the range of INR 265 crores to INR 275 crores this year
guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: Power-One is expected to deliver in the range of INR265 crores to INR275 crores this year.

guidance.summary: Consol capex of between INR 700 crores to INR 850 crores this year
guidance.speaker: Sudhir Goyal
guidance.quote: Achal, this year, we are expecting a consol capex of between like INR700 crores to INR850-odd crores.

guidance.summary: Electronics division revenue to touch about $1 billion in next 3 financial years
guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: Well, yes, we guided that in next 3 financial year, we should be touching about $1 billion revenue, and we seem to be quite on track as far as that is concerned in the Electronics division because of all the growth in the PCBA, PCB and the other building blocks, which we are building on the box build capabilities.

guidance.summary: PCBA revenue should be INR 2,400 crores plus for the year
guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: For Electronics division - We have guided that we should be around INR3,200 crores plus, but only PCBA should be INR2,400 crores plus.

guidance.summary: Working capital for financial year '27 in same range as financial year '26
guidance.speaker: Sudhir Goyal
guidance.quote: So working capital for the financial year '27 will be almost in the same range what we were having in the financial year '26.

guidance.summary: Working capital days around 30 to 35 days at consol level for FY26
guidance.speaker: Sudhir Goyal
guidance.quote: It should be around 30, 35 days at consol level.

guidance.summary: Associate or JV loss expected to be between INR 25 crores to INR 30 crores
guidance.speaker: Sudhir Goyal
guidance.quote: So expected loss to be in the tune between INR25 crores to INR30 crores.
